assertions.title: Event emission does not regress entity creation throughput > 10%

steps.expected: Test passes, 100K entity creates complete in < 500ms

evidence.output:
running 1 test
test world::tests::test_event_emission_overhead ... ok
test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 98 filtered out; finished in 0.06s
evidence.observation: Test creates 100K entities with components and measures wall-clock time. Asserts completion in < 500ms. Completed in 0.06s (well under threshold). Note: the test uses an absolute time threshold (<500ms) rather than a direct percentage comparison, because events are always enabled and there is no 'without events' baseline to compare against. The threshold approach is a reasonable proxy for ensuring overhead stays negligible.
